summary: Audited and enforced strict multi-tenant isolation and zero fixture bleeding between RBPC competition demo fixtures and production tenant data. Configured dynamic DEMO_MODE resolution with fail-closed production checks, added DEMO DATA warning banners on preview pages, verified 100% negative abuse isolation on empty production tenants, and verified absence of fraudulent or synthetic transactions in production DB.

demo_mode_flag.fail_closed_validation: RuntimeError raised if demo_mode=True in production environment

contracts.tenant_isolation_rule: Inquiries strictly scoped via (RbpcInquiry.provider_id == current_user.id OR RbpcExperience.provider_id == current_user.id). Empty production tenants receive 0 inquiries even when other providers have records.

ui_transparency_badges./rbpc/partner: Displays 'DEMO DATA' banner in unauthenticated/preview mode; 'LIVE TENANT' badge with strict scoping notice when authenticated
ui_transparency_badges./rbpc/inquiries: Displays 'DEMO DATA' ribbon highlighting simulated inquiries isolated from live commercial transactional records

anti_fraud_rules: Zero synthetic customer bookings in production
No FAKE- or INQ-TEST- records in production DB

risks.mitigation: demo_mode_effective automatically derives false from environment='production', preventing accidental exposure even if DEMO_MODE env var is omitted.
Public status tracking only falls back to seed items on network errors or local dev mock when unauthenticated, with clear DEMO DATA banner shown.
